video_title: Wemby is Coming for MVP & the Rest of the NBA Should Be TERRIFIED

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama's aggressive playstyle and paint dominance
quotes.excerpt: He's aggressive on the paint. He's aggressive in the low block. He's aggressive in attacking the rim.

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: The change in that is he's going to the paint. He's aggressive on the paint. He's aggressive in the low block. He's aggressive in attacking the rim. Whereas before last year, you probably get bumped a little but he'd settle for a fade. He's getting down there into the paint. And once you do that, nobody can stop you with that. I don't care who you are.

text_blocks.speaker: The Kid Mero
text_blocks.text: I think that's what everybody was just asking him to do. I think all throughout the Western Conference Finals, he just dominated the paint so much, nothing, nobody could do anything about it. It worked.

quotes.speaker: The Kid Mero
quotes.summary_phrase: Cooper Flagg's rapid rise and Tim McMahon's high praise
quotes.excerpt: Tim McMahon said the only prospect that he wouldn't take over him is Wembanyama.

text_blocks.speaker: The Kid Mero
text_blocks.text: I think maybe he probably listened to us last week because we were talking about Cooper Flagg on the podcast about how great he's going to be and he's already top 10 and, you know, Tim McMahon said, you know, the only prospect that he wouldn't take over him is Wembanyama. Plays the Dallas Mavericks that night and drops 52 points.

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: He's still the guy. He's still the guy.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Wembanyama's development and focus on physical play
quotes.excerpt: Now it's the physical part of it. How do I handle the physicality?

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: Again, with him, and I don't hold it against him, he's young. If he got everything right right now, then what are we going to look forward to? We are going to cap him. If he got everything right right now. But for him to now hear the noise, go in there and work on that, work on getting in the paint, okay, I'm going to work on my handle, I'm going to work on my physicality, I'm going to go play rugby. I'm working on the physical part of the game. I worked on the mental part of the game which was up in the mountains with the shallow monks. We got the balance and the mindset. Now it's the physical part of it. How do I handle the physicality? How do I handle getting bumped off the spots? Playing through it.

text_blocks.speaker: The Kid Mero
text_blocks.text: And we see that. He's playing through it.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Wembanyama's legitimate pursuit of the MVP award
quotes.excerpt: He's going for MVP, bro. Like, let's not, he's going for MVP.
quotes.quote: He's going for MVP, bro. Like, let's not, he's going for MVP. MVP got snatched from him last year. He's going for MVP. That's the mindset for him. Because he's a competitor, he understands this game, he's a student of this game.

quotes.speaker: The Kid Mero
quotes.summary_phrase: Wembanyama's dominance when playing a simple game
quotes.excerpt: When he's not trying to do anything super fancy, he's just making the game very simple.

text_blocks.speaker: The Kid Mero
text_blocks.text: It's those parts of his game that when he's locked in and he's not trying to do anything super fancy, he's just making the game very simple. That's when he's truly his scariest. Because now, once the simple parts of the game are coming easy to him, that's when his ability to take people off the dribble, his ability to shoot from deep, his ability to do everything else on the perimeter, that's what makes it just terrifying.

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: You can't do, you can't do all of that and not have your hips right. You can't be able to take that, that bump when somebody hits you in your hip and move you. You can't go through that contact, you can't finish through that contact.
